_comment: Source of truth for the DEV vLLM serverless endpoint (issue #1). The prod twin is created at the prod cutover with name vllm-ministral-prod. All values here are explicit — no console-only settings (infra #13 principle).
name: vllm-ministral-dev
gpu_tier: 24GB (same tier as the retired Ollama endpoint: RTX 3090 / L4 / A5000 class)

env.HF_TOKEN: <create at huggingface.co after accepting the model's terms — required to download the weights>

_licensing: Ministral 3 (2512) family is Apache 2.0 — usable commercially. Do NOT substitute Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410: it is Mistral Research License (non-commercial).
_request_surface: OpenAI-compatible: https://api.runpod.ai/v2/<ENDPOINT_ID>/openai/v1/chat/completions with Bearer <RUNPOD_API_KEY>. Supports response_format json_schema (server-enforced structured output — the property the Mistral-API control run validated).
